issue_request: FHIR-31854 was a Published/Persuasive BRR change request for R5 asking that ClinicalUseIssue.interaction.management allow multiple management actions by changing the element cardinality to 0..*.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in commit 3958057d48219c33eb7f6f198f18afcff93b9235, which changed ClinicalUseIssue.interaction.management from max 1 to max * and was merged by 22b219363b9499e7eb406a99868e80569f186ce8.
additional_context: FHIR-31847 later renamed ClinicalUseIssue to ClinicalUseDefinition. The current fhir.ini makes clinicalusedefinition=ClinicalUseDefinition an active resource and lists ClinicalUseDefinition=normative while the old ClinicalUseIssue normative entry is commented out. Later management-related source work added management elements to contraindication and undesirableEffect without reverting interaction.management. Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-31854 community reference or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/clinicalusedefinition/structuredefinition-ClinicalUseDefinition.xml already defines ClinicalUseDefinition.interaction.management with min 0 and max *.
